news.title: Alkane strikes massive sulphides at Rockley
news.summary: Alkane Resources has made a significant copper-zinc-silver discovery at its Rockley project in New South Wales, with maiden drilling at the Belmore East prospect intersecting multiple zones of massive sulphide mineralisation. The discovery follows a five-hole diamond drilling program totalling 849m at the project’s Apsley exploration licence, approximately 35km south of Bathurst.
